children: Luxury ski resort company Vail Resorts
will be reporting earnings this Monday after market close. Here’s what you need to know.

Vail Resorts missed analysts’ revenue expectations last quarter, reporting revenues of $1.21 billion, down 7% year on year. It was a mixed quarter for the company, with a narrow beat of analysts’ EBITDA estimates but a miss of analysts’ EPS estimates. It reported 7.28 million skier visits, down 15.5% year on year.
Is Vail Resorts a buy or sell going into earnings?

params.linkText: Read our full analysis here, it’s free for active Edge members

children: This quarter, the market is expecting Vail Resorts’s revenue to be flat year on year, slowing from the 2.2% increase it recorded in the same quarter last year.

Analysts covering the company have generally reconfirmed their estimates over the last 30 days, suggesting they anticipate the business will stay the course heading into earnings. Vail Resorts has missed Wall Street’s revenue estimates multiple times over the last two years.

Looking at Vail Resorts’s peers in the consumer discretionary segment, some have already reported their Q2 results, giving us a hint as to what we can expect. Lucky Strike posted flat year-on-year revenue, missing analysts’ expectations by 2.1%, and Dave & Buster's reported a revenue decline of 2.4%, falling short of estimates by 2.3%. Lucky Strike traded down 3.9% following the results while Dave & Buster's was also down 19%.

In the last twelve months or so, the market has shifted its attention from one area of macro importance to the next (AI disintermediation and AI capex spending to geopolitical conflict, rates, and whether the economy is on solid footing or not). While some of the consumer discretionary stocks have shown solid performance in this choppy environment, the group has generally underperformed, with share prices down 8.4% on average over the last month. Vail Resorts is down 4.1% during the same time and is heading into earnings with an average analyst price target of $144.77 (compared to the current share price of $136.14).

title: Vail Resorts (MTN) Q2 Earnings: What To Expect
